"""🚩 Gajjala gates G1–G4 — the pre-registered replay (2026-10-30). READ-ONLY: Mongo reads, files under --out only.

THE PREREG (frozen before any run): eod-audits/research/2026-10-30_gajjala_gates_prereg.md. Ajay 2026-10-29, verbatim:
  "For the missing gaps please idenfity solutions that you fit appropriate for all … I would like you to take control
   of the startegy an ideal one"
Every variant value below is copied from that file; none is tuned here. 13 single-gate trials + 1 combined = 14.

  G1 break-bar proof   A+ only when the 5-min break bar CLOSES above the trigger AND its volume ≥ k × the mean volume
                       of the base bars, k ∈ G1_K.
  G2 red closes        not A+ when the base has more than GC.RED_CLOSES_WAIT (GG's own 3) consecutive red closes.
                       Read with the detectors' own `red_closes` (the RED_CLOSES_MODE "criterion" engine, ONE engine).
  G3 stale / missed    no lane entry when the ring is older than m minutes at the tick (m ∈ G3_M_MIN) or the price at
                       the tick is past trigger + MISSED_R × R (MISSED_R ∈ G3_MISSED_R). The tick = the 🏁 grader's
                       fill minute; the price at the tick = its fill price.
  G4 stop-distance cap not A+ when (trigger − stop)/trigger > c %, c ∈ G4_C_PCT; on 🎾 the stop is frozen at the first
                       armed read (the first 5-min pass whose 🎾 read is `potential_kind` "armed" with the alert's
                       trigger). A FILTER only: the trade's own stop and R are the alert's.

COHORT. Every 🚩 A+ that RANG on the 5-minute page (gajjala_ledger kind "aplus", line "live") + the ⏪ replay rows
(gajjala_replay, state "replayed") on sessions with no live row. The 1-minute page is never read. A row is a TRADE when
its same-session 🏁 grade filled; R is the 🏁 grade's own math (win = +LEDGER_R_MULT R; loss = the stop; open / flat =
its close) minus COST_BPS_PER_SIDE per side. A trade whose gate inputs cannot be read off the cached bars (no minutes
on file, or today's detectors do not re-read the break at the claim's entry bar) leaves EVERY trial and the baseline
(counted, printed).

SPLIT. The cohort's sessions in date order; the first two-thirds (strategy lab OOS_NUM / OOS_DEN rule) are in-sample:
each gate's variant with the highest in-sample mean net R is its pick (ties → prereg order); the combined rule = every
gate's pick. The last third is read once, in this one run, for the picks, the combined rule and the baseline only —
the per-trial table carries no out-of-sample column for a variant that was not picked.

GATES OF RECORD (the strategy lab's in-script engines, imported): A = OOS mean net R > 0 with the whole-entry-week
bootstrap CI (LAB.BOOT_DRAWS) above 0; B = the gate beats ≥ LAB.PLACEBO_BEAT_SHARE of PLACEBO_SETS random same-size
draws from the same OOS cohort; C = DSR ≥ LAB.DSR_PASS (PSR against LAB.dsr_sr0 of the 14 trials' in-sample per-trade
Sharpes). POSITIVE word = LAB.positive_verdict (TOO SMALL under LAB.MIN_CLUSTERS OOS entry weeks). SHIP word (the
prereg's weaker rule): OOS mean ≥ the baseline's AND beat share ≥ SHIP_BEAT_SHARE → SHIP, else OFF; UNMEASURED when the
OOS read has fewer than LAB.MIN_CLUSTERS entry weeks (the rule's mechanical answer is printed beside it).

SAFETY. Refuses 09:30–16:00 ET on a weekday (gajjala_study.refused_window). Mongo through read-only handles (every
write method raises; pymongo's own write methods are also patched to raise). trading.broker / alpaca can never be
imported. Nothing is fetched: bars come from the app's intraday_cache only.

RUN (a throwaway `docker run --rm` off the api image, outside RTH):
  python -m scripts.gajjala_gates_study_2026_10_30 --out /out --prereg /prereg.md --sha <worktree HEAD>
EXIT: 0 written · 2 refused (RTH, a broker module loaded, Mongo unreadable).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import csv
import hashlib
import importlib.abc
import json
import os
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from chart_maps.gajjala import bars as BARS

from scripts import gajjala_losers as LS
from scripts import gajjala_study as S
from scripts import resiliency_study as RS
from scripts import strategy_lab_2026_10_29 as LAB

ET = ZoneInfo("America/New_York")
STUDY = "gajjala_gates_2026_10_30"
PREREG_NAME = "2026-10-30_gajjala_gates_prereg.md"

# ── frozen in the prereg (copied, never tuned) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
G1_K = (1.0, 1.5, 2.0)                  # prereg G1 "k ∈ {1.0, 1.5, 2.0}"
G2_MAX_RED = GC.RED_CLOSES_WAIT         # prereg G2 "> 3 … No variants (GG's own number)" = the app's constant
G3_M_MIN = (10, 20, 30)                 # prereg G3 "m ∈ {10, 20, 30}"
G3_MISSED_R = (0.5, 1.0)                # prereg G3 "MISSED_R ∈ {0.5, 1.0}"
G4_C_PCT = (8.0, 10.0, 12.0)            # prereg G4 "c ∈ {8 %, 10 %, 12 %}"
COST_BPS_PER_SIDE = 10.0                # prereg Method "a conservative 10 bps/side cost"
SHIP_BEAT_SHARE = 0.80                  # prereg Ship rule "beats ≥ 80 % of the placebo draws"
N_TRIALS = 14                           # prereg "3 + 1 + 6 + 3 = 13 … plus 1 combined = 14"
PLACEBO_SETS = LAB.PLACEBO_SETS         # prereg "1,000 draws" (= the lab's number)
POSITIVE_BEAT_SHARE = LAB.PLACEBO_BEAT_SHARE   # prereg "beat ≥ 95 % of them"
DSR_PASS = LAB.DSR_PASS                 # prereg "DSR ≥ 0.95"
BOOT_DRAWS = LAB.BOOT_DRAWS             # the lab's A: 10,000 draws, whole entry weeks
MIN_WEEKS = LAB.MIN_CLUSTERS            # the lab's TOO SMALL line (OOS entry weeks)
SEED = 20261030                         # any fixed value — the prereg's date
HORIZON = GC.LEDGER_HORIZONS[0]         # "same": the lane is flat at the close (no overnight hold)
GATES = ("G1", "G2", "G3", "G4")
SQUEEZE = "reversal_squeeze"

BLOCKED_IMPORTS = ("trading.broker", "alpaca", "trading.gajjala_entry")
WRITE_METHODS = ("insert_one", "insert_many", "update_one", "update_many", "replace_one", "delete_one", "delete_many",
                 "find_one_and_update", "find_one_and_replace", "find_one_and_delete", "bulk_write", "create_index",
                 "create_indexes", "drop", "drop_index", "drop_indexes", "rename", "aggregate_raw_batches")
READ_METHODS = ("find", "find_one", "distinct", "count_documents")


# ── safety ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
class _NoBroker(importlib.abc.MetaPathFinder):
    def find_spec(self, name, path, target=None):
        if any(name == b or name.startswith(b + ".") for b in BLOCKED_IMPORTS):
            raise ImportError(f"{STUDY}: {name} is never imported by this study")
        return None


def broker_loaded() -> list:
    return sorted(m for m in sys.modules if any(m == b or m.startswith(b + ".") for b in BLOCKED_IMPORTS))


GRID_STUB_FLAG = "__gajjala_gates_display_stub__"


def grid_stub():
    """A DISPLAY-ONLY stand-in for `trading.broker`. The detectors import the broker's price grid only to print the
    prices inside their criterion strings (tab._px); no number this study reads (trigger, stop, base, red_closes,
    state, entry_bar_t) passes through it — tests pin that the reads are identical with the real module. Prices
    print unrounded. It has no client, no order call, no key."""
    import types
    m = types.ModuleType("trading.broker")
    m.DOLLAR_DECIMALS = 2
    m.price_decimals = lambda px: 4
    m.round_price = lambda px, how="nearest": float(px)
    setattr(m, GRID_STUB_FLAG, True)
    return m


def install_no_broker() -> None:
    """Block the real broker modules for the life of the process and put the display-only grid stub in their place."""
    if not any(isinstance(f, _NoBroker) for f in sys.meta_path):
        sys.meta_path.insert(0, _NoBroker())
    sys.modules.setdefault("trading.broker", grid_stub())


def real_broker_loaded() -> list:
    return [m for m in broker_loaded() if not getattr(sys.modules.get(m), GRID_STUB_FLAG, False)]


class ReadOnlyColl:
    """A collection handle that can only read. Any other attribute raises."""

    def __init__(self, coll):
        self._c = coll

    def __getattr__(self, name):
        if name in READ_METHODS:
            return getattr(self._c, name)
        raise PermissionError(f"{STUDY}: {name} refused — Mongo is read-only here")


def guard_pymongo_writes() -> None:
    """Belt and braces: every pymongo Collection write method raises for the life of the process."""
    from pymongo.collection import Collection

    def refuse(name):
        def fn(*_a, **_k):
            raise PermissionError(f"{STUDY}: pymongo {name} refused — Mongo is read-only here")
        return fn
    for name in WRITE_METHODS:
        if hasattr(Collection, name):
            setattr(Collection, name, refuse(name))


# ── R per trade (the 🏁 grade's own math + the prereg cost) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def trade_r(grade: Optional[dict], trigger, stop) -> Optional[dict]:
    """{gross, cost, net, fill_px, exit_px, outcome} in R units (R = trigger − stop), or None when the column is not a
    filled trade with a usable outcome. win → the grader's target; loss → the stop (a touch, Q0); open / flat → the
    column's close (close_pct off the fill)."""
    if not isinstance(grade, dict) or grade.get("entry") != "filled" or grade.get("reason") == "split":
        return None
    plan, r = LG.plan_of(trigger, stop)
    fill = LG._num(grade.get("fill_px"))
    if plan != LG.PLANS[0] or fill is None or not r:
        return None
    out = grade.get("outcome")
    if out == "win":
        exit_px = LG._num(grade.get("target_px"))
    elif out == "loss":
        exit_px = float(stop)
    elif out in ("open", "flat"):
        cp = LG._num(grade.get("close_pct"))
        exit_px = None if cp is None else fill * (1 + cp / 100.0)
    else:
        exit_px = None
    if exit_px is None:
        return None
    gross = (exit_px - fill) / r
    cost = COST_BPS_PER_SIDE / 1e4 * (fill + exit_px) / r
    return {"gross": gross, "cost": cost, "net": gross - cost, "fill_px": fill, "exit_px": exit_px, "outcome": out}


# ── the four gates (pure) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def g1_pass(F, j: int, trigger, base_idx, k: float) -> Optional[bool]:
    """Break bar j CLOSES above the trigger AND its volume ≥ k × the mean volume of the base bars. None = no base."""
    idx = list(base_idx or [])
    if not idx or not (0 <= j < len(F.c)):
        return None
    mv = D._mean(F.v[i] for i in idx)
    return D._and(D.gt(LG._D(F.c[j]), LG._D(trigger)), D.ge(F.v[j], D._mul(mv, k)))


def g2_pass(red_closes) -> Optional[bool]:
    """Pass unless the base ran MORE than GC.RED_CLOSES_WAIT red closes in a row (3 pass, 4 fail)."""
    if isinstance(red_closes, bool) or not isinstance(red_closes, int):
        return None
    return D.le(red_closes, G2_MAX_RED)


def last_red_run(F, idx) -> int:
    """DESCRIPTIVE only: the length of the most recent run of consecutive red closes among `idx` (detectors._is_red)."""
    last = cur = 0
    for k in idx or []:
        if D._is_red(F, k):
            cur += 1
            last = cur
        else:
            cur = 0
    return last


def ring_age_min(at_utc, grade: Optional[dict]) -> Optional[int]:
    """Whole minutes from the ring to the 🏁 fill minute (the lane's tick), LG._whole_min (floor)."""
    f = LG._parse_at((grade or {}).get("fill_t"))
    at = at_utc if isinstance(at_utc, datetime) else LG._parse_at(at_utc)
    if f is None or at is None:
        return None
    return LG._whole_min(LG._aware(at), f)


def g3_pass(at_utc, grade: Optional[dict], trigger, stop, m: int, missed_r: float) -> Optional[bool]:
    """Pass when the ring is at most m minutes old at the tick AND the price at the tick is not past trigger +
    missed_r × R (the lane's `missed`, strict >)."""
    age = ring_age_min(at_utc, grade)
    plan, r = LG.plan_of(trigger, stop)
    fill = LG._num((grade or {}).get("fill_px"))
    if age is None or plan != LG.PLANS[0] or fill is None:
        return None
    missed = LG._D(fill) > LG._D(trigger) + LG._D(missed_r) * LG._D(r)
    return bool(age <= m and not missed)


def risk_pct(trigger, stop) -> Optional[Decimal]:
    plan, r = LG.plan_of(trigger, stop)
    if plan != LG.PLANS[0]:
        return None
    return LG._D(r) / LG._D(trigger) * 100


def g4_pass(trigger, cap_stop, c_pct: float) -> Optional[bool]:
    """Pass unless (trigger − stop)/trigger > c %. `cap_stop` = the alert's stop (🎾: frozen at the first armed read)."""
    p = risk_pct(trigger, cap_stop)
    return None if p is None else bool(p <= LG._D(c_pct))


# ── trials ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _fmt(x) -> str:
    return f"{x:g}"


def single_trials() -> list:
    """The 13 single-gate trials in prereg order."""
    out = [{"id": f"G1_k{_fmt(k)}", "gate": "G1", "params": {"k": k}} for k in G1_K]
    out.append({"id": "G2_red3", "gate": "G2", "params": {"max_red": G2_MAX_RED}})
    out += [{"id": f"G3_m{m}_mr{_fmt(mr)}", "gate": "G3", "params": {"m": m, "missed_r": mr}}
            for m in G3_M_MIN for mr in G3_MISSED_R]
    out += [{"id": f"G4_c{_fmt(c)}", "gate": "G4", "params": {"c": c}} for c in G4_C_PCT]
    return out


def gate_ok(row: dict, trial: dict) -> bool:
    """One trial on one judgeable row (a None input = the gate's proof is missing = not passed)."""
    g, p = trial["gate"], trial["params"]
    if g == "COMBINED":
        return all(gate_ok(row, t) for t in trial["parts"])
    if g == "G1":
        v = row["g1"].get(_fmt(p["k"]))
    elif g == "G2":
        v = g2_pass(row.get("red_closes"))
    elif g == "G3":
        v = g3_pass(row["at_utc"], row["grade"], row["trigger"], row["stop"], p["m"], p["missed_r"])
    elif g == "G4":
        v = g4_pass(row["trigger"], row["cap_stop"], p["c"])
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown gate {g}")
    return v is True


# ── statistics (the lab's engines) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def mean_of(x) -> Optional[float]:
    x = list(x)
    return float(np.mean(x)) if x else None


def week_ci(r: list, weeks: list) -> dict:
    """The lab's A: whole-entry-week bootstrap of the mean (LAB.cluster_draws), 95% percentile CI, RS.verdict word."""
    if not r:
        return {"n": 0, "n_weeks": 0, "mean": None, "ci": None, "word": "too_small"}
    d, nc = LAB.cluster_draws(np.asarray(r, dtype=float), list(weeks), draws=BOOT_DRAWS, seed=SEED)
    ci = RS.ci_of(d, dp=LAB.VERDICT_DP)
    return {"n": len(r), "n_weeks": int(nc), "mean": float(np.mean(r)),
            "ci": [RS._r(ci[0], LAB.SHOW_DP), RS._r(ci[1], LAB.SHOW_DP)] if ci else None,
            "ci_raw": ci, "word": RS.verdict(nc, ci)}


def placebo_beat(pool: list, n_pass: int, gate_mean: Optional[float], *, sets: int = PLACEBO_SETS,
                 seed: int = SEED) -> Optional[float]:
    """The prereg placebo: `sets` random draws of the gate's pass COUNT from the same cohort (without replacement);
    the share of draws whose mean the gate's mean beats (strict >, the lab's convention). None when the gate passes
    nothing or the pool is empty."""
    pool = np.asarray(pool, dtype=float)
    if gate_mean is None or n_pass <= 0 or len(pool) == 0 or n_pass > len(pool):
        return None
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    means = np.array([pool[rng.choice(len(pool), size=n_pass, replace=False)].mean() for _ in range(int(sets))])
    return float(np.mean(gate_mean > means))


def positive_word(ci: dict, beat: Optional[float], dsr: Optional[float]) -> dict:
    a = bool(ci.get("mean") is not None and ci.get("ci_raw") and ci["mean"] > 0 and ci["ci_raw"][0] > 0)
    b = bool(beat is not None and beat >= POSITIVE_BEAT_SHARE)
    c = bool(dsr is not None and dsr >= DSR_PASS)
    v = LAB.positive_verdict(a, b, c, ci.get("n_weeks"))
    return {"word": v["word"], "A": a, "B": b, "C": c}


def ship_word(gate_mean: Optional[float], base_mean: Optional[float], beat: Optional[float], n_weeks: int) -> dict:
    """The prereg ship rule; UNMEASURED under MIN_WEEKS OOS entry weeks (the mechanical answer kept beside)."""
    rule = bool(gate_mean is not None and base_mean is not None and gate_mean >= base_mean
                and beat is not None and beat >= SHIP_BEAT_SHARE)
    if gate_mean is None or int(n_weeks or 0) < MIN_WEEKS:
        return {"word": "UNMEASURED", "rule": "SHIP" if rule else "OFF"}
    return {"word": "SHIP" if rule else "OFF", "rule": "SHIP" if rule else "OFF"}


def split_sessions(dates) -> dict:
    """The lab's last-third rule over the cohort's sessions (date order)."""
    s = sorted({str(d)[:10] for d in dates})
    k = (len(s) * (LAB.OOS_DEN - LAB.OOS_NUM)) // LAB.OOS_DEN
    return {"sessions": s, "is": s[:k], "oos": s[k:]}


def pick(trials: list, scores: dict) -> Optional[dict]:
    """The trial with the highest in-sample mean net R (ties → the first in prereg order); None when none scored."""
    best = None
    for t in trials:
        m = scores.get(t["id"])
        if m is not None and (best is None or m > scores[best["id"]]):
            best = t
    return best


def analyse(rows: list, sessions=None) -> dict:
    """rows = judgeable TRADE rows (each: date, net, week, the gate inputs); `sessions` = EVERY cohort session (the
    prereg's "sessions ordered by date" — every A+ that rang, filled or not; default: the trade rows' own dates).
    -> every number the outputs print."""
    sp = split_sessions(sessions if sessions is not None else [r["date"] for r in rows])
    is_rows = [r for r in rows if r["date"] in set(sp["is"])]
    oos_rows = [r for r in rows if r["date"] in set(sp["oos"])]
    singles = single_trials()
    table = []
    is_mean, is_sr = {}, {}
    for t in singles:
        got = [r["net"] for r in is_rows if gate_ok(r, t)]
        is_mean[t["id"]] = mean_of(got)
        is_sr[t["id"]] = LAB.moments(np.asarray(got, dtype=float))["sr"] if len(got) else None
        table.append({"id": t["id"], "gate": t["gate"], "params": t["params"], "is_n": len(got),
                      "is_cohort": len(is_rows), "is_mean": is_mean[t["id"]], "is_sr": is_sr[t["id"]]})
    picks = {g: pick([t for t in singles if t["gate"] == g], is_mean) for g in GATES}
    comb = {"id": "COMBINED", "gate": "COMBINED", "params": {g: (picks[g] or {}).get("params") for g in GATES},
            "parts": [p for p in picks.values() if p is not None]}
    got = [r["net"] for r in is_rows if comb["parts"] and gate_ok(r, comb)]
    is_mean["COMBINED"] = mean_of(got)
    is_sr["COMBINED"] = LAB.moments(np.asarray(got, dtype=float))["sr"] if len(got) else None
    table.append({"id": "COMBINED", "gate": "COMBINED", "params": comb["params"], "is_n": len(got),
                  "is_cohort": len(is_rows), "is_mean": is_mean["COMBINED"], "is_sr": is_sr["COMBINED"]})
    trial_srs = [is_sr[t["id"]] for t in table]
    base_r = [r["net"] for r in oos_rows]
    base = week_ci(base_r, [r["week"] for r in oos_rows])
    reads = {}
    for key, t in list(picks.items()) + [("COMBINED", comb)]:
        if t is None or (key == "COMBINED" and not comb["parts"]):
            reads[key] = {"pick": None, "oos": week_ci([], []), "beat": None, "dsr": None,
                          "positive": positive_word(week_ci([], []), None, None),
                          "ship": ship_word(None, base["mean"], None, 0)}
            continue
        sel = [r for r in oos_rows if gate_ok(r, t)]
        ci = week_ci([r["net"] for r in sel], [r["week"] for r in sel])
        beat = placebo_beat(base_r, len(sel), ci["mean"])
        defl = (LAB.deflated(np.asarray([r["net"] for r in sel], dtype=float), trial_srs) if len(sel)
                else {"dsr": None, "psr0": None, "sr": None, "sr0": None, "N": len(trial_srs)})
        reads[key] = {"pick": {"id": t["id"], "params": t["params"], "is_n": next(x["is_n"] for x in table
                                                                                   if x["id"] == t["id"]),
                               "is_mean": is_mean[t["id"]]},
                      "oos": ci, "beat": beat, "dsr": defl.get("dsr"), "psr0": defl.get("psr0"),
                      "sr": defl.get("sr"), "sr0": defl.get("sr0"),
                      "positive": positive_word(ci, beat, defl.get("dsr")),
                      "ship": ship_word(ci["mean"], base["mean"], beat, ci["n_weeks"])}
    for x in table:
        x["picked"] = any(rd["pick"] and rd["pick"]["id"] == x["id"] for rd in reads.values())
    return {"split": sp, "is_n": len(is_rows), "oos_n": len(oos_rows), "table": table, "reads": reads,
            "baseline_oos": base, "baseline_is_mean": mean_of(r["net"] for r in is_rows),
            "n_trials": len(table), "trial_srs_finite": sum(1 for s in trial_srs if s is not None)}


# ── inputs off the cached bars ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _base_idx(F, base: Optional[dict]) -> list:
    if not isinstance(base, dict) or base.get("from_t") not in F.t or base.get("to_t") not in F.t:
        return []
    return list(range(F.t.index(base["from_t"]), F.t.index(base["to_t"]) + 1))


def first_armed_stop(f5, j: int, trigger) -> tuple:
    """(stop, bar_t) of the first 5-min pass before the break bar j whose 🎾 read is potential_kind "armed" with the
    alert's trigger; (None, None) when no such pass."""
    for n in range(f5.today.start + 1, j + 1):
        rd = D.reversal_squeeze(S.prefix_frame(f5, n), float_read=S.STUDY_FLOAT)
        if PT.potential_kind(rd) == "armed" and rd.get("trigger") is not None and rd.get("stop") is not None \
                and LG._D(rd["trigger"]) == LG._D(trigger):
            return float(rd["stop"]), rd.get("as_of_bar_t")
    return None, None


def break_inputs(sym: str, d: date, setup: str, entry_bar_t: str, frame: str, trigger, raw_prev, raw_today) -> dict:
    """Re-read the break with today's detectors on the cached bars. -> {"why": None | reason, "g1": {k: bool|None},
    "red_closes", "last_red_run", "base_n", "close", "vol", "base_mean_vol", "armed_stop", "armed_t", "reread_state",
    "reread_trigger"}."""
    out = {"why": None, "g1": {}, "red_closes": None, "last_red_run": None, "base_n": 0, "close": None, "vol": None,
           "base_mean_vol": None, "armed_stop": None, "armed_t": None, "reread_state": None, "reread_trigger": None}
    today = S.day_minutes(raw_today, d)
    if today is None or len(today) == 0:
        return dict(out, why="no cached minutes on the alert's session")
    prev = raw_prev
    if prev is not None and len(prev) and "session" in prev.columns:
        prev = prev[prev["session"].isin(S.LIVE_SESSIONS)]
    everything = S.utc_naive(S.session_bounds(d)["ah_close"]) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
    fr = BARS.build_frames(sym, d, everything, prev, today)
    if fr is None:
        return dict(out, why="no 5-minute bars built")
    F = fr.f15 if frame == "15m" else fr.f5
    if F is None or entry_bar_t not in F.t:
        return dict(out, why="the claim's entry bar is not in the cached bars")
    j = F.t.index(entry_bar_t)
    if frame == "15m":
        n15, n5 = j + 1, int(fr.f5.df.index.searchsorted(F.df.index[j], side="right"))
    else:
        n5 = j + 1
        n15 = int(fr.f15.df.index.searchsorted(F.df.index[j], side="right")) if fr.f15 is not None else 0
    frames = {"5m": S.prefix_frame(fr.f5, n5), "15m": S.prefix_frame(fr.f15, n15) if n15 else None}
    rd = D.read_all(frames, {"symbol": sym, "float_read": S.STUDY_FLOAT}).get(setup) or {}
    out["reread_state"], out["reread_trigger"] = rd.get("state"), rd.get("trigger")
    if rd.get("entry_bar_t") != entry_bar_t:
        return dict(out, why="today's detectors do not re-read the break at the claim's entry bar")
    RF = fr.f15 if rd.get("frame") == "15m" else fr.f5
    idx = _base_idx(RF, rd.get("base"))
    jj = RF.t.index(entry_bar_t) if entry_bar_t in RF.t else j
    out["g1"] = {_fmt(k): g1_pass(RF, jj, trigger, idx, k) for k in G1_K}
    out["red_closes"] = rd.get("red_closes")
    out["last_red_run"] = last_red_run(RF, idx)
    out["base_n"] = len(idx)
    out["close"], out["vol"] = RF.c[jj], RF.v[jj]
    out["base_mean_vol"] = D._mean(RF.v[i] for i in idx)
    if setup == SQUEEZE:
        out["armed_stop"], out["armed_t"] = first_armed_stop(fr.f5, n5 - 1, trigger)
    return out


# ── Mongo (read-only) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def readonly_db():
    from pymongo import MongoClient
    client = MongoClient(os.getenv("MONGO_URL", "mongodb://mongo:27017"), serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000)
    return client[os.getenv("MONGO_DB", "cheetah")]


def readonly_store(db):
    from chart_maps.gajjala import store as ST
    return ST.GajjalaStore(colls={n: ReadOnlyColl(db[n]) for n in (ST.LEDGER, ST.REPLAY, ST.ALERTS)})


FETCHED: list = []                      # (sym, day, got) of every --fetch-missing GET this run (printed in the report)


def readonly_day_loader(db, fetch: Optional[Callable] = None) -> Callable:
    """(sym, day) → the cached 1-minute DataFrame or None — intraday_cache first (daytrading.data._mongo_get_day over a
    read-only handle; never load_intraday, which fetches and WRITES on a miss). `fetch` (--fetch-missing): a session
    the cache does not hold (the 🏁 nightly grades today's session off a live fetch that is never cached) is read ONCE
    through the study's own as-printed GET (gajjala_study._fetch_minutes_http — no write anywhere)."""
    from daytrading import data as DTD
    from sepa.symbols import for_massive
    ro = ReadOnlyColl(db["intraday_cache"])
    DTD._get_mongo_coll = lambda: ro                      # the read path only; its index build is never reached
    DTD._mongo_put_day = lambda *a, **k: None

    def load(sym: str, day: date):
        df = DTD._mongo_get_day(for_massive(sym), day)
        if (df is None or len(df) == 0) and fetch is not None:
            df = fetch(sym, day)
            FETCHED.append((sym, day.isoformat(), df is not None and len(df) > 0))
        return df
    return load


def cohort(docs: list, claim_of: Callable) -> tuple:
    """docs (losers.read_mongo with replay) → (rows, notes). Live A+ rows + replayed rows on sessions with no live row."""
    rows, notes = [], {"docs": len(docs or []), "not_aplus": 0, "replay_on_live_session": 0, "no_entry_bar": 0}
    live_dates = set()
    parsed = []
    for doc in docs or []:
        row = LS.row_of(doc)
        if row is None or row.get("kind") != LG.KINDS[1] or row.get("line") not in (LG.LINES[0], LG.LINES[2]):
            notes["not_aplus"] += 1
            continue
        parsed.append((doc, row))
        if row["line"] == LG.LINES[0]:
            live_dates.add(row["date"])
    for doc, row in parsed:
        if row["line"] == LG.LINES[2]:
            if row["date"] in live_dates:
                notes["replay_on_live_session"] += 1
                continue
            a = doc.get("alert") or {}
            ebt, frame = a.get("entry_bar_t"), a.get("frame") or "5m"
        else:
            c = claim_of(row["date"], row["symbol"], row["setup"]) or {}
            ebt, frame = c.get("entry_bar_t"), c.get("frame") or "5m"
        if not ebt:
            notes["no_entry_bar"] += 1
        g = doc.get(HORIZON) if isinstance(doc.get(HORIZON), dict) else None
        rows.append(dict(row, grade=g, entry_bar_t=ebt, frame=frame))
    rows.sort(key=lambda r: (r["date"], r["at_utc"].timestamp() if r.get("at_utc") else 0.0, r["symbol"],
                             r["setup"]))
    return rows, notes


def build(rows: list, load_day: Callable) -> tuple:
    """Attach R and the gate inputs. -> (all rows, judgeable trade rows)."""
    trades = []
    for r in rows:
        tr = trade_r(r.get("grade"), r.get("trigger"), r.get("stop"))
        r["trade"] = tr
        r["net"] = tr["net"] if tr else None
        fill_t = LG._parse_at((r.get("grade") or {}).get("fill_t"))
        r["week"] = LAB._week_monday(fill_t.astimezone(ET).date().isoformat()) if fill_t else None
        r["ring_age_min"] = ring_age_min(r.get("at_utc"), r.get("grade"))
        rp = risk_pct(r["trigger"], r["stop"])
        r["risk_pct"] = float(rp) if rp is not None else None
        if not r.get("entry_bar_t"):
            r["inputs"] = {"why": "no entry bar on the claim", "g1": {}}
        else:
            d = date.fromisoformat(r["date"])
            raw_today = load_day(r["symbol"], d)
            raw_prev = load_day(r["symbol"], LG._prev_market_day(d))
            r["inputs"] = break_inputs(r["symbol"], d, r["setup"], r["entry_bar_t"], r["frame"], r["trigger"],
                                       raw_prev, raw_today)
        inp = r["inputs"]
        r["g1"] = inp.get("g1") or {}
        r["red_closes"] = inp.get("red_closes")
        r["cap_stop"] = (inp.get("armed_stop") if (r["setup"] == SQUEEZE and inp.get("armed_stop") is not None)
                         else r.get("stop"))
        r["judgeable"] = inp.get("why") is None
        if tr is not None and r["judgeable"]:
            trades.append(r)
    return rows, trades


# ── outputs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def _n(x, dp=3):
    return "—" if x is None else (f"{x:.{dp}f}" if isinstance(x, float) else str(x))


def _ci_text(ci, n_weeks=None) -> str:
    """A CI over one entry week is the mean itself (one cluster resampled) — printed as no interval."""
    if not ci or (n_weeks is not None and int(n_weeks) < 2):
        return "no interval" + (f" ({int(n_weeks)} entry week)" if n_weeks is not None and int(n_weeks) < 2 else "")
    return f"[{ci[0]:.3f}, {ci[1]:.3f}]"


def _params_text(p) -> str:
    if not isinstance(p, dict):
        return "—"
    if all(isinstance(v, dict) or v is None for v in p.values()):
        return " · ".join(f"{g} {_params_text(v)}" for g, v in p.items())
    return ", ".join(f"{k}={_fmt(v) if isinstance(v, float) else v}" for k, v in p.items())


def write_outputs(out: Path, meta: dict, rows: list, trades: list, res: dict) -> None:
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    row_keys = ("date", "symbol", "setup", "line", "rang", "at_et", "trigger", "stop", "risk_pct", "entry_bar_t",
                "ring_age_min")
    with (out / "rows.csv").open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(row_keys + ("split", "outcome", "net_r", "judgeable", "why", "red_closes", "last_red_run",
                               "base_n", "close", "vol", "base_mean_vol", "armed_stop", "cap_stop")
                   + tuple(t["id"] for t in single_trials()))
        oos = set(res["split"]["oos"])
        for r in rows:
            inp = r.get("inputs") or {}
            flags = [("1" if gate_ok(r, t) else "0") if (r["judgeable"] and r["trade"]) else ""
                     for t in single_trials()]
            w.writerow([r.get(k) for k in row_keys]
                       + ["oos" if r["date"] in oos else "is", (r["trade"] or {}).get("outcome")
                          or (r.get("grade") or {}).get("entry"), _n(r["net"], 4), int(r["judgeable"]),
                          inp.get("why") or "", r.get("red_closes"), inp.get("last_red_run"), inp.get("base_n"),
                          inp.get("close"), inp.get("vol"), inp.get("base_mean_vol"), inp.get("armed_stop"),
                          r.get("cap_stop")] + flags)
    write_trials(out / "trials.csv", res)
    js = {"meta": meta, "result": res,
          "rows": [{k: (v.isoformat() if isinstance(v, datetime) else v) for k, v in r.items()
                    if k not in ("grade",)} for r in rows]}
    (out / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(js, indent=2, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "report.md").write_text(render_md(meta, rows, trades, res), encoding="utf-8")


def write_trials(path: Path, res: dict) -> None:
    with path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        w = csv.writer(fh)
        w.writerow(("trial", "gate", "params", "is_cohort", "is_n_pass", "is_mean_net_r", "is_sr_per_trade",
                    "picked", "oos_n", "oos_mean_net_r", "oos_ci95"))
        for t in res["table"]:
            rd = res["reads"].get(t["gate"]) if t["gate"] != "COMBINED" else res["reads"]["COMBINED"]
            show = bool(rd and rd["pick"] and rd["pick"]["id"] == t["id"])
            w.writerow([t["id"], t["gate"], _params_text(t["params"]), t["is_cohort"], t["is_n"], _n(t["is_mean"], 4),
                        _n(t["is_sr"], 4), int(t["picked"]), rd["oos"]["n"] if show else "sealed",
                        _n(rd["oos"]["mean"], 4) if show else "sealed", _ci_text(rd["oos"]["ci"], rd["oos"]["n_weeks"]) if show else "sealed"])


GATE_TEXT = {"G1": "G1 break-bar proof (close > trigger, vol ≥ k × base mean)",
             "G2": f"G2 red closes (≤ {G2_MAX_RED} in a row)",
             "G3": "G3 stale / missed at the tick (age ≤ m min, fill ≤ trigger + MISSED_R × R)",
             "G4": "G4 stop-distance cap (risk ≤ c %, 🎾 stop frozen at the first armed read)",
             "COMBINED": "Combined (every gate's in-sample pick)"}


def gate_lines(res: dict) -> list:
    out = ["| gate | in-sample pick (IS n · IS mean R) | OOS n (weeks) | OOS mean R | 95% CI (entry weeks) | baseline OOS "
           "mean R | placebo beat | DSR (N 14) | POSITIVE | SHIP |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    base = res["baseline_oos"]
    for key in GATES + ("COMBINED",):
        rd = res["reads"][key]
        p = rd["pick"]
        pk = "none" if p is None else f"{_params_text(p['params'])} ({p['is_n']} · {_n(p['is_mean'])})"
        o = rd["oos"]
        ship = rd["ship"]["word"] + (f" (rule alone: {rd['ship']['rule']})" if rd["ship"]["word"] == "UNMEASURED"
                                      else "")
        pos = rd["positive"]["word"] + (" = UNMEASURED" if rd["positive"]["word"] == "TOO SMALL" else "")
        out.append(f"| {GATE_TEXT[key]} | {pk} | {o['n']} ({o['n_weeks']}) | {_n(o['mean'])} | {_ci_text(o['ci'], o['n_weeks'])} | "
                   f"{_n(base['mean'])} | {_n(rd['beat'])} | {_n(rd['dsr'])} | **{pos}** | **{ship}** |")
    return out


def render_md(meta: dict, rows: list, trades: list, res: dict) -> str:
    sp = res["split"]
    nj = [r for r in rows if r["trade"] and not r["judgeable"]]
    why = {}
    for r in nj:
        why[r["inputs"].get("why")] = why.get(r["inputs"].get("why"), 0) + 1
    live = sum(1 for r in rows if r["line"] == LG.LINES[0])
    rep = len(rows) - live
    sq = [r for r in trades if r["setup"] == SQUEEZE]
    sq_armed = sum(1 for r in sq if (r.get("inputs") or {}).get("armed_stop") is not None)
    diff_red = sum(1 for r in trades if r.get("red_closes") is not None and (r.get("inputs") or {}).get("last_red_run")
                   is not None and g2_pass(r["red_closes"]) != g2_pass(r["inputs"]["last_red_run"]))
    g1_none = sum(1 for r in trades if any(v is None for v in r["g1"].values()))
    base = res["baseline_oos"]
    out = [f"# 🚩 Gajjala gates G1–G4: the pre-registered replay ({meta['run_et'][:16]} ET)", "",
           "**Verdict: every gate is TOO SMALL to read (UNMEASURED).** Nothing ships to the paper lane from this run."
           if all(res["reads"][k]["ship"]["word"] == "UNMEASURED" for k in res["reads"]) else
           "**Verdict: see the table; words per the prereg.**", "",
           f"- Prereg: `{meta.get('prereg') or PREREG_NAME}` sha256 `{meta.get('prereg_sha256') or '—'}` (frozen before "
           f"this run). Script `backend/scripts/gajjala_gates_study_2026_10_30.py` sha256 `{meta['script_sha256']}`, "
           f"worktree HEAD `{meta.get('sha') or '—'}`.",
           f"- Run {meta['run_et']} ET, outside 09:30–16:00 ET; a throwaway container, Mongo read-only handles, no "
           f"broker import (display-only price-grid stub), bars = the app's intraday_cache"
           + (f"; {len(meta.get('fetched') or [])} symbol-day(s) the cache lacks read once through the study's "
              f"as-printed GET, never written: "
              + ", ".join(f"{a} {b}" + ("" if c else " (no answer)") for a, b, c in meta["fetched"])
              if meta.get("fetched") else "; nothing fetched") + ".",
           f"- Cohort: {len(rows)} A+ rows that rang ({live} live 🏁 rows, {rep} ⏪ replay rows); "
           f"{sum(1 for r in rows if r['trade'])} filled trades; {len(nj)} trades not judgeable "
           f"({'; '.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k, v in why.items()) or 'none'}) — out of every trial and the baseline; "
           f"**{len(trades)} trades read**.",
           f"- Split (the lab's last-third rule over {len(sp['sessions'])} sessions): in-sample {sp['is'][0] if sp['is'] else '—'}"
           f"…{sp['is'][-1] if sp['is'] else '—'} ({len(sp['is'])} sessions, {res['is_n']} trades); out-of-sample "
           f"{sp['oos'][0] if sp['oos'] else '—'}…{sp['oos'][-1] if sp['oos'] else '—'} ({len(sp['oos'])} sessions, "
           f"{res['oos_n']} trades, {base['n_weeks']} entry week(s)).",
           f"- R = the 🏁 grade's same-session math minus {COST_BPS_PER_SIDE:g} bps per side. Baseline (no gate): "
           f"in-sample mean {_n(res['baseline_is_mean'])} R; OOS mean {_n(base['mean'])} R, {_ci_text(base['ci'], base['n_weeks'])}.",
           f"- **N honestly: {base['n']} OOS trades in {base['n_weeks']} entry week(s), against the lab's {MIN_WEEKS}-week "
           f"floor.** A CI over fewer than {MIN_WEEKS} weeks is not an interval anyone should read.", "",
           "## Per gate", ""]
    out += gate_lines(res)
    out += ["", f"POSITIVE = the strategy lab's A + B + C ({POSITIVE_BEAT_SHARE:.0%} placebo, DSR ≥ {DSR_PASS}); TOO SMALL "
            f"under {MIN_WEEKS} OOS entry weeks. SHIP = the prereg's weaker rule (OOS mean ≥ baseline AND placebo beat "
            f"≥ {SHIP_BEAT_SHARE:.0%}); UNMEASURED under {MIN_WEEKS} OOS entry weeks, the rule's mechanical answer "
            f"beside it. DSR: PSR of the pick's OOS per-trade R against LAB.dsr_sr0 of the {res['n_trials']} trials' "
            f"in-sample per-trade Sharpes ({res['trial_srs_finite']} finite).", "",
            "## Per trial (in-sample; OOS sealed except the picks)", "",
            "| trial | params | IS n pass / cohort | IS mean net R | IS SR | picked |", "|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for t in res["table"]:
        out.append(f"| {t['id']} | {_params_text(t['params'])} | {t['is_n']} / {t['is_cohort']} | {_n(t['is_mean'])} | "
                   f"{_n(t['is_sr'])} | {'yes' if t['picked'] else ''} |")
    if meta.get("run_note"):
        out += ["", "## Run history", "", meta["run_note"]]
    out += ["", "## Judgement calls and caveats", "",
            "- G2 reads the detectors' own `red_closes` (the longest run among the pullback / base bars — the "
            "RED_CLOSES_MODE 'criterion' engine). The prereg says 'the base's last run'; on the trades read, the two "
            f"readings disagree on **{diff_red}** trade(s).",
            "- G3's tick = the 🏁 grader's fill minute (the lane enters at the first tick the tape trades the trigger); "
            "the price at the tick = the grader's fill price. Ring age = whole minutes, floor (LG._whole_min).",
            f"- G4 is a filter only; on 🎾 the cap reads the stop of the first armed read ({sq_armed} of {len(sq)} 🎾 "
            "trades had one with the alert's trigger; the rest read the alert's stop). The trade's stop and R stay the "
            "alert's.",
            f"- G1: a break with no base bars reads 'no proof' (not passed): {g1_none} trade(s).",
            "- In-sample pick = the highest in-sample mean net R; ties → prereg order.",
            "- The live 🏁 grades were made at the 20:15 ET nightly on the live minute fetch; the gate inputs are re-read "
            "on the intraday_cache copy of those minutes with TODAY's detectors.",
            "- The study cache named in the run brief was not used: its scratch directory is gone (empty); the replay rows "
            "carry their own stored grades.", ""]
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def ledger_rows(res: dict, meta: dict) -> list:
    """One LEDGER.md row per gate (+ the combined trial), in the ledger's column order."""
    out = []
    base = res["baseline_oos"]
    for key in GATES + ("COMBINED",):
        rd = res["reads"][key]
        p = rd["pick"]
        o = rd["oos"]
        word = rd["positive"]["word"]
        out.append(
            f"| {meta['run_et'][:10]} | gates {key} | {GATE_TEXT[key]}; pick "
            f"{_params_text(p['params']) if p else 'none'} (in-sample {res['split']['is'][0] if res['split']['is'] else '—'}"
            f"…{res['split']['is'][-1] if res['split']['is'] else '—'}); R = 🏁 same-session math, "
            f"{COST_BPS_PER_SIDE:g} bps per side | **{word}**{' (= UNMEASURED)' if word == 'TOO SMALL' else ''}; SHIP "
            f"word **{rd['ship']['word']}** (rule alone {rd['ship']['rule']}). Read {meta['run_et'][:16]} ET{meta.get('ledger_note') or ''}, "
            f"prereg 2026-10-30_gajjala_gates_prereg.md sha256 {str(meta.get('prereg_sha256') or '—')[:12]}… | "
            f"{_n(o['mean'])} R (baseline {_n(base['mean'])} R) | {_ci_text(o['ci'], o['n_weeks'])} | {_n(rd['dsr'])} (N = 14 in "
            f"this study) | OOS {o['n']} trades / {o['n_weeks']} entry week(s); IS {p['is_n'] if p else 0} | placebo "
            f"beat {_n(rd['beat'])} (95% POSITIVE, 80% SHIP). Outputs: research/gajjala_gates_2026_10_30/. |")
    return out


def inputs_summary(rows: list, notes: dict) -> str:
    """The --inputs-only smoke line: cohort and judgeability counts only — never an outcome, an R or a gate pass."""
    why: dict = {}
    for r in rows:
        w = (r.get("inputs") or {}).get("why") or "judgeable"
        why[w] = why.get(w, 0) + 1
    sp = split_sessions(r["date"] for r in rows)
    sq = [r for r in rows if r["setup"] == SQUEEZE and (r.get("inputs") or {}).get("why") is None]
    return (f"rows {len(rows)} · sessions {len(sp['sessions'])} (IS {len(sp['is'])} / OOS {len(sp['oos'])}) · "
            f"notes {notes} · inputs {why} · 🎾 judgeable {len(sq)}, armed read found "
            f"{sum(1 for r in sq if r['inputs'].get('armed_stop') is not None)}")


def render_only(args) -> int:
    """Re-render the human files from a saved results.json (no Mongo, no bars, no outcome re-read)."""
    js = json.loads(Path(args.render_only).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    meta, res, rows = js["meta"], js["result"], js["rows"]
    if args.run_note:
        meta["run_note"] = Path(args.run_note).read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
    meta["ledger_note"] = args.ledger_note or meta.get("ledger_note") or ""
    trades = [r for r in rows if r.get("trade") and r.get("judgeable")]
    out = Path(args.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out / "report.md").write_text(render_md(meta, rows, trades, res), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "ledger_rows.md").write_text("\n".join(ledger_rows(res, meta)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    write_trials(out / "trials.csv", res)
    print(f"re-rendered from {args.render_only} → {out}")
    return 0


def _sha256(p: Path) -> Optional[str]:
    try:
        return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    except OSError:
        return None


def main(argv=None, *, now: Optional[datetime] = None, docs: Optional[list] = None,
         claim_of: Optional[Callable] = None, load_day: Optional[Callable] = None) -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="python -m scripts.gajjala_gates_study_2026_10_30", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True, metavar="DIR")
    ap.add_argument("--prereg", metavar="FILE")
    ap.add_argument("--sha", metavar="HEAD")
    ap.add_argument("--fetch-missing", dest="fetch_missing", action="store_true",
                    help="a session intraday_cache lacks: one as-printed Massive GET (never written)")
    ap.add_argument("--render-only", dest="render_only", metavar="RESULTS_JSON",
                    help="re-render report.md / trials.csv / ledger_rows.md from a results.json — reads no data")
    ap.add_argument("--run-note", dest="run_note", metavar="FILE", help="a markdown file printed as the run history")
    ap.add_argument("--ledger-note", dest="ledger_note", default="", help="text after the read time in the ledger rows")
    ap.add_argument("--inputs-only", dest="inputs_only", action="store_true",
                    help="smoke: read the cohort and the gate inputs, print their counts; no outcome, no R, no file")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if args.render_only:
        return render_only(args)
    now_et = (now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)).astimezone(ET)
    if S.refused_window(now_et):
        print("refused: 09:30–16:00 ET on a weekday — nothing read")
        return 2
    loaded = broker_loaded()
    if loaded:
        print(f"refused: a broker module is loaded ({', '.join(loaded)}) — nothing read")
        return 2
    if docs is None:                                            # the real run: lock imports and writes for the process
        install_no_broker()
        guard_pymongo_writes()
        db = readonly_db()
        store = readonly_store(db)
        try:
            docs = LS.read_mongo(store, include_replayed=True)
        except Exception:                                       # noqa: BLE001
            docs = None
        if docs is None:
            print("refused: the 🏁 ledger / replay could not be read — nothing written")
            return 2
        from chart_maps.gajjala import alerts as AL
        coll = store.alerts_coll()
        claim_of = claim_of or (lambda d, s, st: coll.find_one({"_id": AL.claim_key(d, s, st)}))
        load_day = load_day or readonly_day_loader(db, S._fetch_minutes_http if args.fetch_missing else None)
    rows, notes = cohort(docs, claim_of or (lambda *a: None))
    rows, trades = build(rows, load_day or (lambda *a: None))
    if args.inputs_only:
        print(inputs_summary(rows, notes))
        return 0
    res = analyse(trades, [r["date"] for r in rows])
    prereg = Path(args.prereg) if args.prereg else None
    meta = {"study": STUDY, "run_et": now_et.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "sha": args.sha,
            "prereg": PREREG_NAME, "prereg_sha256": _sha256(prereg) if prereg else None,
            "script_sha256": _sha256(Path(__file__)), "notes": notes, "n_trials": N_TRIALS,
            "frozen": {"G1_K": G1_K, "G2_MAX_RED": G2_MAX_RED, "G3_M_MIN": G3_M_MIN, "G3_MISSED_R": G3_MISSED_R,
                       "G4_C_PCT": G4_C_PCT, "COST_BPS_PER_SIDE": COST_BPS_PER_SIDE,
                       "SHIP_BEAT_SHARE": SHIP_BEAT_SHARE, "PLACEBO_SETS": PLACEBO_SETS,
                       "POSITIVE_BEAT_SHARE": POSITIVE_BEAT_SHARE, "DSR_PASS": DSR_PASS, "BOOT_DRAWS": BOOT_DRAWS,
                       "MIN_WEEKS": MIN_WEEKS, "SEED": SEED},
            "broker_modules_after": real_broker_loaded(), "fetched": list(FETCHED),
            "broker_stub": bool(getattr(sys.modules.get("trading.broker"), GRID_STUB_FLAG, False))}
    out = Path(args.out)
    write_outputs(out, meta, rows, trades, res)
    (out / "ledger_rows.md").write_text("\n".join(ledger_rows(res, meta)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    for key in GATES + ("COMBINED",):
        rd = res["reads"][key]
        print(f"{key}: pick {_params_text((rd['pick'] or {}).get('params'))} · OOS n {rd['oos']['n']} "
              f"({rd['oos']['n_weeks']} wk) · mean {_n(rd['oos']['mean'])} · base {_n(res['baseline_oos']['mean'])} · "
              f"beat {_n(rd['beat'])} · DSR {_n(rd['dsr'])} · {rd['positive']['word']} · {rd['ship']['word']}")
    print(f"rows {len(rows)} · trades read {len(trades)} · → {out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
